text: Evening. You climb back up into the stands, and walk straight into a wall of people.
Fifty thousand people, all trying to leave at the same time.
The exits are called vomitoria. They were built to pour a full stadium into the streets, fast.
But a panicking crowd can push harder than any wall was built to hold.
You lose your footing. Someone grabs your arm, and pulls you out of the stream.
And then, slowly, it becomes quiet.
Night. The stands are empty. Torches flicker along the wall.
The gates are shut. The city is asleep. And you are still inside.
Tomorrow, it all begins again. Ninety-nine more days.
So, tell me. Would you survive a single day?
